system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
A plugin is one YAML file (prompt-injection points + config overrides + profiles +
lifecycle hooks + an eval contract); a Skill is a markdown playbook the agent loads on
demand at runtime.
system_prompt_style.note: Inferred from plugin prompt-injection points and on-demand skills; no prompt-building code seen in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
Given one idea, it faithfully implements the
  code changes, runs the experiment in an isolated git worktree, and reports evidence.
env_context_strategy.note: Coordinator reads Idea Tree state; repo context via executor tools. Tool list not in evidence.

context_compaction.note: README mentions 'context mgmt' in src/core/ but mechanism not shown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
It provided
the REPL framework, tool-calling infrastructure, and cross-platform compilation
tool_call_format.note: Providers are Anthropic Messages / OpenAI Responses / chat completions; parser not shown.

tool_schema_source.note: Arbor also exposes tools as an MCP server (arbor mcp).

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Run Arbor's keyless deterministic tools as an MCP server (needs the `[mcp]` extra).

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Shared infrastructure: ReAct loop, tools, LLM providers, context mgmt
loop_primitives.note: Coordinator runs hypothesis-tree arbor cycle; EventBus with typed events in src/events/.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
Depth 1:** research directions (paper-title-level ideas).
- **Depth 2+:** concrete methods, implemented and tested by Executors.
planning_granularity.note: Idea Tree is a persistent nested plan with delegation to executors.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
selected hypotheses are sent to independent Executors, which
   implement them in fresh worktrees and evaluate them on the dev signal.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: ④ DISPATCH  run an Executor on it in an isolated git worktree

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Set `ui.interaction_mode` (or `--interaction-mode`) to choose how much you steer:
human_in_loop.note: Default CLI flow requires confirming research contract (on_plan); review mode pauses before each node/Executor. auto mode is fully autonomous.

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
Results, failure modes, and distilled insights live in a
  persistent Idea Tree — not a scrollback buffer.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Each run leaves concrete, reusable findings — a dataset quirk that helped, a trap to avoid; the next similar task recalls them at intake
long_term_memory.note: Storage format not shown; skills are markdown playbooks under src/skills/.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Runs are resumable —
interrupt with `Ctrl+C` and continue later with `--resume`; Arbor reloads the Idea Tree and
picks up where it left off.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
Executors iterate on a **dev** split, but a change is
kept only if it clears a margin on the **held-out test** split

rollback.evidence_quote: Each Executor works in its own worktree on a dedicated branch.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Hard cap on coordinator ReAct turns — a cost/runaway safety valve.
termination_condition.note: Also --max-cycles; coordinator may decide to stop.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Claude via the native Anthropic Messages API (signed thinking + prompt caching).
cost_controls.note: Token budget not confirmed in evidence beyond turn caps.

timeouts.note: Plugins supply timeout presets; mechanism not shown.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Each Executor works in its own worktree on a dedicated branch.
execution_isolation.note: Git worktree isolation on host; no container evidence.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
`--cwd` is the default boundary;
  external paths must be named explicitly and are re-authorized after chat resume.

tracing.evidence_quote: Each run writes a session directory with `REPORT.md`, `events.jsonl`, `run_stats.json`

replayability.evidence_quote: Replay any past run's `events.jsonl` from its timeline
replayability.note: Replay is visualization of events, not re-execution.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
`arbor benchmark verify <dir>`
structurally checks a pack, and `arbor benchmark list` indexes the zoo.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A generalist autonomous research agent — runs experiments, researches, and iteratively optimizes, autonomously.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
Anthropic, OpenAI / Responses API, and
  OpenAI-compatible backends via LiteLLM

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Arbor's native CLI runtime and Agent Skill Suite (Codex / Claude Code) are released.
primary_artifact.note: Paper arXiv 2606.11926 (2026-06-10); repo v0.1.4 later. Unrelated AMD paper arXiv 2606.12563 shares the name.

first_release_date.note: Release announced 2026-06-12 in README News; first tag not in evidence.
